payload.summary: Safe number editor: two managers saving at almost the same moment can overwrite each other's cover needs
payload.detail: The editor (Manage, Team settings, PR #3431) re-reads the team's needs, then sends needs.set, which replaces the whole list. The read and the write are separate requests, so a dated, grade or site need, or a safe number, that another manager saves in that gap is lost. Undo has the same gap. Closing it needs a database change (owner's explicit yes required): a version check on the team's needs so needs.set only succeeds against the list it read, else re-read and ask the manager to retry. Then add a test that interleaves a second save between the read and the write. Raised by Qodo on PR #3431, left open by choice as rare. Josh asked for it to be recorded 2026-10-10.
